stem.text: Two reactions are shown. Only one product is identified in each reaction.
Which statement about these reactions is correct?

A.text: The formations of both ethanal and sodium ethoxide are redox reactions.

B.text: The formations of both ethanal and sodium ethoxide result in colour changes.

C.text: The formation of ethanal is catalysed by potassium dichromate.

D.text: The formation of sodium ethoxide is a dehydration reaction.
